lint: ruff check warpack tests benchmarks examples: passed
format: ruff format --check warpack tests benchmarks/experimental benchmarks/upstream/adapters.py benchmarks/upstream/cupy_plugin.py examples/block_reuse.py: passed
scope: Experimental adapter and benchmark changes only; installed core unchanged. This is focused component/application validation; latest full local suite remains the preceding 593-test block-api-validation.json, not a new full/upstream rerun.
runtime: Pinned unmodified Warp 1.18.0+cu12 FSAI/batched-CG overlay; no stock Warp 1.15 claim for this experimental adapter.
capture_query_note: Final code uses current-stream is_capturing rather than device is_capturing. Identical predicate in recorded single-stream benchmarks; avoids uncaptured condition readback if another stream is capturing. Both forms only inspect capture metadata, never numerical residuals.
